newsitem.title: USA: Digital Products CEO, directors quit.
newsitem.headline: Digital Products CEO, directors quit.

text.p: Electronic device-maker Digital Products Corp said on Tuesday its president and vice president had resigned and been replaced and two directors had also quit.
The company also said in a news release it has "suffered significant operating losses and is experiencing severe liquidity problems."
Digital Products, which issued no financial details, said it expected it would have to restructure its outstanding debts and was seeking additional financing. It gave no timetable for any actions.
Digital Products said Ben Khoshnood, president and chief executive, and Robert Chalnick, vice president and secretary, resigned on January 14.
A day earlier, January 13, Col. Clinton Pagano (Retired) and Henry Hudson had resigned from the Board of Directors of Digital Products for personal reasons.
Digital Products said Leo Carson, now vice president and sales director, had been named interim president. Jane Gomez was named vice president, controller and secretary, the company said.
The company manufactures electronic monitoring equipment for prisons.
